answer_1.quote: We conduct evaluations using LLaMA-3.1-8B (Team., 2024) and Mistral-7B-v0.3 , along with two benchmarks: ZsRE and SelfCheck-GPT.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to closed‑book QA prompts and corrected factual statements for hallucination mitigation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt three primary evaluation metrics: Reliability (Rel.), Generality (Gen.), and Locality (Loc.) ... For the hallucination setting ... we primarily use two metrics: Perplexity (PPL) and Locality (Loc.).
